title: Define an operator recovery disposition for unresolved closing checkpoint duties
outcome: A reviewed operator recovery contract covers Unknown ordinary and missing-session Teardown duties without lending authority, erasing unresolved producer work, or releasing unrelated exclusions.
acceptance: Document the owner-approved operator recovery or disposition contract for Unknown ordinary and missing-session Teardown checkpoint duties, including authorization and exact duty/receipt preservation.
Implement only the approved contract through existing lifecycle and authority owners, with positive recovery and negative stale-owner/unrelated-duty/restart controls.
Obtain the required independent reviews and exact-input tests for the implemented scope.
